summary: Implemented E3052, E3053 and E3054 as three keyword-triggered rules under src/cfnlint/rules/resources/ecs/ (ServiceNetworkConfiguration.py, TaskDefinitionAwsVpc.py, ServiceFargate.py), with three matching test modules in test/unit/rules/resources/ecs/. The ECS tests pass (82), and the broader test/unit/rules plus rules-collection tests pass (998). Nothing was committed. Tests were run with PYTHONPATH pointing at this tree's src, because the shared venv's editable install points at a different checkout. Black and ruff are not installed in the venv, so formatting was checked only by line length (no line over 88 columns), not by the tools. A port-override bug in E3053 (path left at NetworkMode) was found by the tests and fixed by resetting the path to the Properties location while keeping the NetworkMode condition scope.
